item.title: NEWS IN 10 每日新聞英語｜11 月 15 日
item.description: NEWS IN 10 每日新聞英語｜11 月 15 日 【新聞 1】輝達執行長黃仁勳因醜聞辭職，衝擊晶片產業 Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Scandal, Impacting Chip Industry • Nvidia's CEO, Jensen Huang, recently **resigned** from his position. 輝達執行長黃仁勳最近已辭去其職位。 - resigned /ɹɪzˈaɪnd/ (v.) 辭職 • Reports suggest his departure followed an investigation into **alleged** affairs. 報導指出，他的離職是因一項針對其被指控婚外情的調查。 - alleged /əlˈɛdʒd/ (adj.) 被指控的 • These included a suspected Chinese spy and an Nvidia executive. 其中包括一名疑似中國間諜和一名輝達高階主管。 • This news has caused significant concern across the global semiconductor industry. 這則新聞已在全球晶片產業中引起了廣泛關注。 • His exit could challenge Nvidia's supply chain and market standing. 他的離職可能會對輝達的供應鏈和市場地位構成挑戰。 來源： https://www.forbes.com/sites/charlesbovaird/2026/11/13/jensen-huang-ousted-timeline-of-the-nvidia-scandal/ https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/12/jensen-huang-resigns-nvidia-ceo-alleged-affairs 【新聞 2】人工智慧提升仿生視覺技術，造福盲人患者 AI Enhances Bionic Vision Technology for Blind Patients • Scientists have developed an **advanced** AI system for bionic vision technology. 科學家們開發了一套用於仿生視覺技術的先進人工智慧系統。 - advanced /ədvˈænst/ (adj.) 先進的 • This new approach makes experimental **bionic** vision more **precise**. 這種新方法使實驗性的仿生視覺更加精確。 - bionic /bˌaɪˈɔnɪk/ (adj.) 仿生學的 - precise /pɹɪsˈaɪs/ (adj.) 精確的 • It helps predict light flashes and shapes **perceived** by blind individuals. 它有助於預測盲人所感知到的光線閃爍和形狀。 - perceived /pɚsˈivd/ (v.) 感知；察覺 • The AI learns how a patient's brain implant processes visual information. 這套人工智慧學習患者腦部植入物如何處理視覺資訊。 • This **breakthrough** could greatly improve life quality for many. 這項突破有望大幅改善許多人的生活品質。 - breakthrough /bɹˈeɪkθɹˌu/ (n.) 突破 來源： https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261110103000.htm https://mindplex.ai/article/ai-helps-an-experimental-bionic-eye-adapt-to-a-persons-brain 【新聞 3】比特幣在市場波動中暴跌至數月新低 Bitcoin Plunges to Multi-Month Low Amid Market Volatility • Bitcoin's value recently **tumbled** to a four-month low. 比特幣的價值最近暴跌至四個月來的最低點。 - tumbled /tˈʌmbəld/ (v.) 暴跌 • The **cryptocurrency** fell below the significant $70,000 threshold. 這種加密貨幣跌破了重要的七萬美元關卡。 - cryptocurrency (n.) 加密貨幣 • This decline was due to aggressive market **liquidations**. 這次下跌是由於市場上積極的清算活動。 - liquidations /lˌɪkwɪdˈeɪʃənz/ (n.) 清算 • Hot **macroeconomic** inflation figures also contributed to the selling pressure. 火熱的宏觀經濟通膨數據也加劇了拋售壓力。 - macroeconomic /mˌækɹoʊɛkənˈɑmɪk/ (adj.) 宏觀經濟的 • Investors are now closely watching for further market movements. 投資人目前正密切關注市場的進一步動向。 來源： https://www.forbes.com/sites/charlesbovaird/2026/11/13/bitcoin-falls-below-70000-to-reach-lowest-since-august/ https://beincrypto.com/bitcoin-plunges-62000-market-manipulation-claims/
